answer: Keeping 243 aliases alive thus means 243 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the knoll quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the meadow log shows the live set and the tide audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 830 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
